# Superlaunch

> Set up Superlaunch, manage advertising workflows, and connect AI agents through MCP.

## Start here

- [Superlaunch documentation](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/index.md): Connect your accounts, work with AI agents, and manage campaigns in Superlaunch.
- [Current product capabilities](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/reference/capabilities.md): Find reporting, AutoRules, Launcher, Meta actions, memory, team access, and their MCP discovery tools.
- [Set up Superlaunch](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/quickstart.md): Connect your first Meta ad account and check a report.
- [How Superlaunch works](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/concepts/how-it-works.md): Analyze ad performance, reuse creative work, and automate campaign tasks with your team or an AI agent.
- [IDs, versions, and retries](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/concepts/ids-and-versions.md): Use the right identifiers and avoid duplicate operations.

## Workspace

- [Connect ad platforms](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/workspace/connections.md): Authorize Meta, choose accounts, and recover a disconnected connection.
- [Team and permissions](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/workspace/permissions.md): Manage workspace members and control access to accounts, rules, and launches.

## Workflows

- [Analyze performance](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/guides/insights.md): Choose comparable dates, metrics, attribution, and reporting levels.
- [Import custom metrics](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/guides/custom-metrics.md): Add daily values from a CSV file, then use them in Insights and Rules.
- [Create and run rules](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/guides/rules.md): Define targets, conditions, actions, schedules, and dry-run checks.
- [Review activity and results](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/guides/activity.md): Trace tool calls, provider actions, and rule runs to their outcomes.
- [Brand profiles and kits](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/guides/brands.md): Give your team and agent the brand guidance they need.
- [Save and manage memory](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/guides/memory.md): Save facts for later conversations and choose who can use them.

## API

- [Custom metrics](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/reference/custom-metrics-api.md): Create metric definitions, prepare and commit imports, and query values with the public API.
- [Ad accounts](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/reference/ad-accounts-api.md): List the ad accounts that a team API key can access.
- [Get an API key](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/reference/api-keys.md): Create and store a team API key for public API requests.
- [Authorization](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/reference/api-authorization.md): Send a team API key and understand public API access checks.

## Launcher

- [Launcher overview](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/launcher/overview.md): Save creative versions, reuse campaign settings, and run immediate or scheduled launches.
- [Upload and import media](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/launcher/media.md): Add images and videos to the shared library or import selected Drive files.
- [Create and version creatives](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/launcher/creatives.md): Save immutable content versions, select exact versions, and review their media.
- [Organize collections](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/launcher/collections.md): Use fixed selections or smart filters to choose creatives for launches.
- [Create launch templates](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/launcher/templates.md): Save versioned campaign settings, budgets, destinations, and naming.
- [Prepare and submit a launch](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/launcher/launch.md): Select an operation, saved content, target, timing, and delivery status.
- [Schedule recurring launches](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/launcher/schedules.md): Set recurring timing, selection behavior, and batch limits.
- [Inspect and recover launches](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/launcher/recovery.md): Understand partial results and choose retries or replacement work.

## MCP

- [Superlaunch MCP](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/overview.md): Connect an AI client to your workspace's advertising data and operations.
- [Connect an MCP client](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/connect.md): Set up Superlaunch in ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, or another OAuth client.
- [Authentication and access](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/authentication.md): Understand OAuth scopes, workspace selection, and revocation.
- [Your first MCP workflow](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/first-workflow.md): Verify access and ask your agent for a read-only performance check.
- [MCP workflows](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/workflows.md): Use discovery, validation, writes, and result checks in the right order.
- [MCP troubleshooting](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/troubleshooting.md): Resolve connection, permission, input, and result-completeness problems.
- [MCP tool index](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/tools.md): Find all 115 documented MCP tools by task, access requirement, and exact input schema.
- [MCP argument examples](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/examples.md): Valid argument shapes for discovery, reporting, campaign validation, memory, and launch polling.

## MCP reference

- [Accounts, assets, and brands](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/reference/accounts-brands.md): Resolve Superlaunch account and brand IDs before reading or changing objects.
- [Insights tools](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/reference/insights.md): Query reports and rank advertising performance.
- [Rule tools](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/reference/rules.md): Create rules, edit their conditions, and inspect runs.
- [Custom metric tools](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/reference/custom-metrics.md): Create definitions, import values, check tasks, and query metrics through MCP.
- [Direct Meta actions](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/reference/actions.md): Upload media, create or update Meta objects, duplicate setups, and change delivery status.
- [Activity tools](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/reference/activity.md): Use the unified log for tool calls, actions, and rule operations.
- [Memory tools](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/reference/memory.md): Save facts only after an explicit request or focused approval.
- [Launcher library tools](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/reference/launcher-library.md): Manage media, creative versions, approvals, collections, and templates.
- [Launcher launch tools](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/reference/launcher-launches.md): Discover exact provider assets and targets before preparing a launch.
- [Launcher schedules and limits](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/reference/launcher-schedules.md): Create recurring launches and set account campaign and budget limits.
- [Launcher Drive tools](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/reference/launcher-drive.md): Authorize Google Drive and select files or folders in Superlaunch first.

## Support

- [Billing and usage](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/support/billing.md): Review the workspace subscription, usage, payments, and access state.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/support/troubleshooting.md): Resolve common workspace, reporting, rule, and launch problems.
- [Glossary](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/reference/glossary.md): Definitions for the terms used in Superlaunch and its MCP tools.
- [Documentation for AI assistants](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/reference/ai-access.md): Read the public documentation index, full text, and page Markdown.

## Text and workspace access

- [Full documentation](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/llms-full.txt): Combined text of the published documentation.
- [Product MCP](https://mcp.superlaunch.pro/mcp): OAuth-protected access to authorized workspace data and operations.
